title: Moroccan Chicken with Taleggio Fries
description: A flavorful and savory Moroccan-inspired dish featuring chicken and melted Taleggio cheese. Serve with crispy Taleggio fries for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Season the chicken breasts with cumin, coriander, and paprika.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken until browned on both sides and cooked through.
Transfer the chicken to a baking dish and top with sliced Taleggio cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Meanwhile, peel the potatoes and cut into fry shapes.
Heat the fry in a deep frying pan until hot. Fry the potatoes until crispy and golden brown.
Serve the chicken with the Taleggio fries and garnish with chopped onion and parsley.
